{"children":[["paragraph",{"numbering":"#none","indent-level":0,"children":[["text",{"value":"A: Welcome, everybody. The first thing I’d like to discuss at this meeting is the number of new clients we managed to attract in the last quarter. In general, at Trenton Menswear, we attract at least twenty new retailers per month who wish to stock our clothing lines. As you can see, December was our least successful month. The reason for this is that our sales department was understaffed that month due to the holidays. Our second lowest month for new clients was when the sales and marketing departments were being remodeled. This work caused some disruption to our schedules. Now, this year, we plan to attract a greater number of clients by making our product line larger and more diverse."}]]}]]}

Như các bạn có thể thấy, tháng 12 là tháng kém thành công nhất của chúng tôi. Nguyên nhân là vì bộ phận bán hàng của chúng tôi thiếu nhân viên do nghỉ lễ vào tháng đó.
